user.title: Connect to your Power Pet Door
user.description: Enter the address of the Power Pet Door on your network. The door must be on the same network as Home Assistant.

data_description.name: The name shown for this door in Home Assistant.
data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the door.
data_description.port: The port the door listens on. Leave at 3000 unless you have changed it.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Power Pet Door
reconfigure.description: Update the address of an existing Power Pet Door, for example after changing its IP address.

data_description.name: The name shown for this door in Home Assistant.
data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the door.
data_description.port: The port the door listens on. Leave at 3000 unless you have changed it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the door at that address.
error.timeout_connect: The door did not answer in time.
error.invalid_response: Something answered at that address, but it is not a Power Pet Door.

abort.already_configured: This door is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The door's address has been updated.

init.title: Power Pet Door options
init.description: Connection timings, and the range offered by the hold-open time control.

data_description.timeout: How long to wait for the door to answer a command, in seconds.
data_description.reconnect: How long to wait before reconnecting after the connection drops, in seconds.
data_description.keep_alive: How often to ping the door to keep the connection alive, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.refresh: How often to ask the door for its full state, in seconds. The door reports changes as they happen, so this is only a safety net.
data_description.hold_min: The lowest value the hold-open time control offers, in seconds.
data_description.hold_max: The highest value the hold-open time control offers, in seconds.
data_description.hold_step: The increment between values on the hold-open time control, in seconds.

error.hold_range_inverted: The minimum hold-open time must not be greater than the maximum.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace the schedule for a Power Pet Door sensor. Targets the inside or outside schedule entity.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Days mapped to time windows, in Home Assistant's schedule format: each day name maps to a list of from/to pairs. Days you omit are cleared.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the Power Pet Door at {host}:{port}.

command_failed.message: The door did not accept the command: {error}

unknown_timezone.message: No POSIX timezone rule could be derived for {timezone}.

schedule_update_failed.message: The door did not accept the new schedule: {error}
